executionHistory.summary: DOCUMENT-ONLY RUN. Recorded a verified cross-cutting finding: Gate G087 (planning_packet_implementation_linkage_gate) has no truthful satisfaction path under this repository's in-place delivery model. (A) SPEC-013-SPECIFIC, LATENT: commit b525326d certified specs/013-market-regime-stack-and-strategy-playbook to specs_hardened while G087 was wired and live; replaying planning-packet-linkage-guard.sh against a git-archive of that commit exits 1 with 'has status specs_hardened and planningOnly is not true, but linkedImplementationSpec is missing or empty'. The risk is LATENT, NOT ACTIVE and is deliberately not overstated: 013 graduated at commit 602f32db to full-delivery / in_progress, G087 fires only at specs_hardened, and the guard exits 0 against 013 at HEAD. (B) SYSTEMIC, ACTIVE: bubbles.validate attempted to certify specs/016-auction-gamma-playbook to specs_hardened, the guard returned failedGateIds [G087] / blockingCode PLANNING_GATE_FAILED, and validate REVERTED THE PROMOTION IN FULL; 016 remains not_started / not_started / null with 0 of 197 DoD boxes checked across 9 scopes. ROOT CAUSE VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED: G087 assumes a planning-packet-to-SEPARATE-implementation-spec topology; this repository delivers IN PLACE, a packet graduating its own workflowMode and implementing its own scopes, as recorded in 013's own modeTransition object (authority operator-directed) which states 'G087 governs planning packets that hand off to a separate implementation spec; it does not govern self-delivered specs' and that both mechanical escapes were 'refused at the time as untruthful'. A repo-wide sweep confirmed ZERO specs carry planningOnly:true and ZERO carry a non-null linkedImplementationSpec. TWO FRAMING CORRECTIONS recorded truthfully rather than silently accepted: the linkage keys at b525326d were PRESENT with falsy values (linkedImplementationSpec null, planningOnly false, planningOnlyJustification null) rather than absent, and 016's reverted promotion IS durably recorded at top-level .executionHistory rather than the nested .execution.executionHistory path that returns empty; neither changes the conclusion. FOUR CANDIDATE RESOLUTION DIRECTIONS were recorded WITHOUT selecting one, since the choice is an owner / framework decision: D1 explicit in-place delivery classification, D2 self-referencing linkedImplementationSpec (recorded but already refused as untruthful by 013's own record), D3 G087 framework amendment, D4 repository convention that packets graduate directly and never occupy specs_hardened. Plus orthogonal follow-ups F1 registry wiring description fix and F2 disposition of 013's historical certification. SCOPE OF THIS RUN: no fix attempted, no resolution direction chosen or implemented, zero DoD boxes checked across all three scopes, no certification field asserting anything, no .html/.js/.mjs file created or modified, specs/013-* and specs/016-* read only and never written, no file under .github/bubbles/** patched, and the concurrent BUG-004 packet's files (market-heatmap-lab.html, rlexperience.js, rlbrief.js and related tests) not touched, reverted, stashed or committed.
